metadata_interface_review.qualification: Requires the actual positive RQ6 archive/root/atomic confirmation/final posttool chain, exact actual driver/wrapper/posttool exits and same qualified manifest. Inherited complete root/fresh/wrapper/posttool preparer scope comes from the exact copied validator; no old negative proof grants ownership or qualification.
metadata_interface_review.actual_task_rows: Consumes the actual campaign.tasks LIST with exactly ordered regression/classification kinds, not a guessed dictionary. Report paths must be absolute and present in the independent qualified actual_artifact_sha256 map before metadata use.
metadata_interface_review.strong_authority: Copies only the actual independently qualified report.spec and raw selected recipe, recursively forbids fit_iterations in raw recipes, binds source report/root and both actual split SHA roles. No historical deployment tree is transferred.
metadata_interface_review.numeric_witness: Reads only the source-bound explicit data dictionary metadata. Predictor names must have role exactly feature; only dtype exactly numeric enters numeric_features, in qualified spec.features order. Binary/unknown/non-numeric entries are omitted rather than inferred from not-categorical. Target/ID features remain forbidden.
metadata_interface_review.data_scope: Qualified original data and NPZ pin values are reused as metadata without opening arrays/rows. The future producer deliberately reads the bounded data_dictionary.csv metadata only, plus code/JSON report metadata and hashes.
metadata_interface_review.finite_current_observation: Freshly checks the actual complete prior known identity set with exact birth matching; only NoSuchProcess or a different observed birth establish prior identity absence. Denial/unknown errors abort. Current preparer identities are captured separately and never claimed absent by their own observation.
metadata_interface_review.current_preparers: The actual producer emits a pinned sidecar and PENDING actual tool. Root must observe producer exit0 and replace only the external pending binding before any readiness grant. Future outer fresh checks include those captured preparers.
metadata_interface_review.paths_and_census: Typed path/SHA references including contract rows are resolved and collision-checked. Every current contract method map is independently AST-enumerated; exactly nine30-second parent slots total270 inside setup300. No tests are executed by preparation.
metadata_interface_review.future_source_dependency: The final reviewed outer may change core source references/census, but its predecessor and strong_authority bodies must remain AST-identical to the projected validators. Its independent peer must retain the explicitly consumed result/reviewed_handoff schema. A semantic change requires an explicit source rebind, not an assumed generic compatibility.

remaining: After actual RQ6 positive closure and final outer source peer, root supplies exact input-plan metadata, observes bounded producer exit, verifies resulting typed refs/preparer union, performs independent private peer and exact final config/predecessor preflight before assigning a new experiment clock.
